project.title: Transcriptomic analysis of Stutzerimonas stutzeri WH-01 grown on different inorganic nitrogen sources
project.description: RNA-seq was performed on Stutzerimonas stutzeri WH-01 grown with a mixed nitrogen source (MN), nitrate (NAT), or nitrite (NIT), with three biological replicates per treatment (nine samples in total), on the Illumina HiSeq platform (paired-end, 150 bp). The aim was to identify differentially expressed genes associated with partial denitrification and the response to nitrate stress.
